stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 7.

"It was difficult for my parents to send me to school, but now all the facilities are in the village. I have started planning for my daughter's future education. I want to see her become a doctor or engineer." 

This quotation shows that —

options.label: A
options.text: Rezwan’s efforts have improved educational conditions for future generations

options.label: B
options.text: Farida thinks that there are enough facilities in her village to serve all the children

options.label: C
options.text: Rezwan believes that his school boats will create many doctors and engineers

options.label: D
options.text: Farida’s own difficulties in attending school cause her to be doubtful about her daughter’s education
